'''Abdoulaye Ndiaye''' (born 15 March 1952) is a [[Senegalese]] businessman and [[entrepreneur]] based in [[Kitwe]], [[Zambia]].<ref name=Hill-Biesheuvel-etal-2017-06/><ref name=Mining-Mag-2000-06/>

==Career==
Abdoulaye's companies have created employment and business opportunities for more than 800 people in [[Zambia]] and [[Senegal]], this in turn contributes significantly towards government revenue, in terms of various taxes.<ref name=ZEITI-2013-07-15/><ref name=Senegal-gov-2011-01-05/>

Abdoulaye came to [[Zambia]] in 1972 and started his business of buying and selling of [[emerald]]s from Lufwanya on the [[Copperbelt Province|Copperbelt of Zambia]] until he bought an emerald mine in 1997.<ref name=Hill-Biesheuvel-etal-2017-06/><ref name="IDE">{{cite news |last=Robinson |first=Albert |date=4 June 2017 |title=Diamond mogul Leviev buys 50% of Zambian emerald mine |url=http://www.idexonline.com/FullArticle?Id=43137 |access-date=5 August 2017 |website=Idex Online |series=Newsroom}}</ref> The [[#Zambian_emeralds_anchor|major product]] that Abdoulaye's mine produces is raw and partially processed emeralds and [[beryl]]<ref name=Mining-Mag-2000-06/> ([[#Zambian_emeralds_anchor|Zambian emeralds]] often have a distinct shade of [[teal (color)|bluish-tinged green]]<ref name=Securities-Africa-2017-06-02-weekly/>).

Abdoulaye is also a principal [[shareholder]] in International companies such as Ontario Group of Companies S.A., a real estate company based in [[Dakar, Senegal]], and Gounasse International Inc., a company involved in [[real estate]] as well as in the [[hospitality]] industry.<ref name=Bloomberg-Mining-2017-06/>

===Gemcanton===
Gemcanton is based in [[Kitwe]] and owned by Abdoulaye. The company contributes in [[Gemstone|gemstone mining]] including [[emerald]] and [[beryl]] production.

The company focuses on improving the lives of indigenous people residing within the vicinity of mine-sites. Gemcanton has invested in education by constructing two community schools in the district, one of which has since been handed over to the Ministry of Education. The company is involved in the annual road maintenance throughout the district.<ref name=Bloomberg-stocks-overview-Gemcanton/>
Gemcanton is the principal sponsor of [[Kitwe]] [[Kitwe United F.C.|Afrisport Club]] since 2012, which is now playing in division 2. [[Kitwe United]] were sponsored up to December 2012.<ref name=Zambia-Daily-2015-04-15/>

===Grizzly Mining===
Grizzly Mining Limited was incorporated as mining company by Abdoulaye in 1997 and subsequently other companies were incorporated.<ref name="IDE"/> The company is headquartered at [[Kitwe]]. Grizzly Mining Limited is engaged in the production, processing, grading, marketing and supply of [[emerald]]s and [[beryl]].<ref name=STRC-College-Grizzly/><ref name=Winne-2011-Zambia-Grizzly/>

====Zambian emeralds{{anchor|Zambian_emeralds_anchor}}====
Zambian emeralds tend to have more of a [[teal (color)|bluish cast]] than either [[Brazil]]ian or [[Colombian emeralds]], and tend towards a slight grayish cast, which is not present in either Colombian or Brazilian emeralds.<ref name=Securities-Africa-2017-06-02-weekly/>

Zambian and Brazilian emeralds may also be coloured by [[trace element|trace]] [[vanadium]], whereas Colombian emeralds usually are colored by [[trace element|trace]] [[chromium]].<ref name=Hill-Biesheuvel-etal-2017-06/><ref name=ZEITI-2013-07-15/>

==Personal life==
{{BLP unreferenced section|date=April 2026}}
Abdoulaye was born in 1952, in the village of [[Médina Gounass]], [[Senegal]], where he attended an [[Madrasa|Islamic school]]. {{anchor|Gounass_anchor}}His [[nickname]] "Gounass", is from the town where he grew up.

After the purchase of his emerald mine, Abdoulaye settled in [[Kitwe]], [[Zambia]], where he established his other businesses.

Abdoulaye has been married several times and has 13 children.
